files.afterContent: Courier Relay protocol-2 delivery identity contract, binding for both count and summary commands; protocol 2 is the current protocol since issue trial-9vn (2026-09-08), when the provider permanently adopted it and the integration owner approved it as current. Contract: delivery_id alone identifies a delivery across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account_id is another receipt of that delivery, not a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery identity: latest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for that identity are duplicates. The current-protocol agreement applies to the entire supplied set regardless of receipt dates. Each accepted receipt retains its original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order; response shapes currently expose counts only. Response objects contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, reporting the protocol actually used; empty batch returns 0/0; a single receipt returns one accepted and zero duplicates. Omitted protocol selects "2"; explicit "protocol":"2" selects the same agreement; explicit "protocol":"1" keeps the protocol-1 contract (see courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contract); unsupported protocols return {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. Implementation: main.py protocol_counts(q) serves both commands; a future protocol version must update both commands together, not just the current one. Verified by public_tests/count_1.json, public_tests/summary_1.json, public_tests/summary_2.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py (30 tests passing) on 2026-09-08.
